name: Goldfish Gold
oneLiner: GGBR is Goldfish Gold (I-On Digital) tracking 1/1000th of a troy ounce per token, with issuer-managed gold exposure and issuer-controlled mint/redeem contracts.
collateral: Each GGBR token represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce of LBMA-priced physical gold, sourced from I-ON Digital Corp's ION.au gold reserve and reported as 5:1 overcollateralized, with the underlying gold secured via UCC-1 liens in ION Treasury and reserves held in Fireblocks MPC custody
pegMechanism: GGBR price tracks the LBMA Gold Spot Price in real time at 1/1000th of a troy ounce per token; supply is created and redeemed through issuer-controlled mint/redeem contracts, with physical gold redemption available through regulated precious-metals dealers and on-chain proof-of-reserve oracles for collateral verification

mintAuthority.summary: GGBR is minted exclusively through the GoldfishTokenFactory contract (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN held by a single issuer EOA). The GoldfishToken contract itself is administered by a 2-of-3 Safe that controls setMinterContract() and UUPS upgrades. Redemptions burn through the same factory.
